svg.title: Chobundo documented construction details
svg.desc: A source card separates Chobundo's named Natsume spout, Komagata knob and arare, and Japanese-lacquer coloring evidence from unestablished details.
svg.text: Chobundo: named detail evidence stays attached to named models
Natsume: handmade spout; thin-wall casting. Komagata: arare, pine-cone knob, bamboo-leaf detail.
Named current kettles: Japanese-lacquer coloring. Kiku: vermilion copper lid in catalogue record.
NOT ESTABLISHED: fitting originality, historic route, or an attribution rule for an unproven object.
Source: 2024 prefectural catalogue. Text card, not a reconstructed object or mark illustration.
